# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

## [1.0.20] - 2026-08-11

### Fixed bugs

- Fixed bugs

## [1.0.19] - 2026-08-11

### Delete comments

- Delete comments

## [1.0.18] - 2026-08-10

### Added

- Added optional className support for scrollbar and thumb.
- className now takes precedence over per-element style options and the selected theme.

## [1.0.17] - 2026-08-09

### Fixed bugs

- Fixed scrollbar overlay positioning so it follows the target container instead of always rendering from the viewport/body.
- The overlay now uses a local portal host for in-block scroll containers and a fixed host for page-scrolling targets.

## [1.0.16] - 2026-08-09

### improvement

- Added the ability to set custom styles via className

## [1.0.15] - 2026-08-07

### Added CHANGELOG

- Added CHANGELOG

## [1.0.14] - 2026-07-27

### Architectural overhaul

- Fundamentally reworked the scrollbar container rendering mode.

## [1.0.13] - 2026-07-26

### Fixed bugs

- Fixed a fatal error when resizing the viewport.

## [1.0.12] - 2026-07-26

### Fixed bugs

- Fixed scrollbar animations when resizing the viewport.

## [1.0.11] - 2026-07-26

### Fixed bugs

- Fixed positioning on viewport resize.
- The scrollbar now appears correctly when the viewport is resized.

## [1.0.10] - 2026-07-26

### Fixed bugs

- Fixed positioning for `after` mode.
- The scrollbar now appears correctly after the element.

## [1.0.9] - 2026-07-25

### Fixed bugs

- Fixed scrollbar behavior in windows that extend beyond the viewport.
- The scrollbar now hides correctly when the parent element moves outside the viewport.

### Fixed bugs
